_meta.description: vle-thermo bundled component database (Milestone 10; Cp added M12.1; ammonia added M14)

units.psat_coeffs: reduced Antoine ln(Psat/Pc) = a1 - a2/(a3 + T), T in K
units.cp_coeffs: dimensionless ideal-gas Cp/R = sum a_k*T^k (k=0..4), T in K
units.cp_t_range: [t_min, t_max] K validity window of the Cp fit
